content: Philippine AML: RA 9160 as amended (RA 10365, RA 11521) plus the 2018 IRR, amended by 2021 BSP circular, added real estate developers and brokers to 'covered persons' (DNFBP). A cash transaction with a real estate developer/broker above PHP 7.5M is a covered transaction; realty transactions above PHP 500k flow through the Registry of Deeds' Realty Transaction Report. Covered persons must do customer identification (CIP), verification (CVP), beneficial-ownership verification for juridical buyers, ongoing monitoring, and file CTRs/STRs; they must have written customer-acceptance policies and sanctions screening. Separately RA 10173 (DPA) requires a lawful basis; NPC Circular 2023-04 (consent) and 2023-07 (legitimate interest) reject implied/soft opt-in consent, require specific, time-bound, withdrawable consent evidenced by written/electronic/recorded means, a separate mechanism for data sharing and automated decision-making, and a privacy notice stating purposes and retention. Practical implication: a consent ledger must record purpose, version, timestamp, channel, and withdrawal - not a single checkbox.
